saw_lines: Gluten-free buyers check every label, then stick with the one bread or snack that tastes right and reorder it for months.
So a new buyer scrolls past a static bread photo with no reason to try it, and the sale is lost.
Your 15 live ads include no video at all, so new buyers never see the bread move. Shoot three short videos of Fladenbrot being warmed and filled, then run them first.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 15 ads are video, so new buyers never see the bread move or warm up. Shoot three short videos of Fladenbrot being warmed, filled and eaten, and test them against your Dönerabend ad.
None of your 15 ads shows a proof number, so a first time buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Collect one, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next three ads with it.
Only one ad carries an offer, 34 % off the sampler packs, so the other 11 give a new buyer no reason to act today. Put a first order offer, with a figure you set, on three new ads.

6 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of your 9 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest winner, keeping its opening line and swapping in a new product.
